matches.rationale: Finding 1 shows that the Theorem 2.1 formula is only valid when the Rayleigh-quotient quantity α equals the true top eigenvalue k_1, i.e. when the principal eigenfunction is constant — exactly the 'missing condition' that makes the theorem too general. Finding 2 independently identifies the same gap by showing the proof conflates single-point conditioning with full-path survival conditioning, which again shows the theorem/lemma chain lacks the needed exception, so both findings detect the same core defect from different angles (R2/R3).
